best_candidate.description: signed log1p EMG features plus train-only standard scaling

failure_reason_ranking.reason: Intervention targeted scale/distribution more than cross-subject affective alignment.
failure_reason_ranking.evidence: Preprocessing was weak/diagnostic and first-pass macro-F1 remained near chance.

failure_reason_ranking.reason: CE-only objective does not explicitly suppress subject identity or align same-affect samples across subjects.
failure_reason_ranking.evidence: Previous diagnostics found subject-dominated representations; current CE-only preprocessed run was insufficient.

failure_reason_ranking.reason: Subject-relative labels improved balance/definition but did not guarantee separable affective representation.
failure_reason_ranking.evidence: Both EEG and EMG subject-relative preprocessed runs remain mixed across folds/tasks.

failure_reason_ranking.reason: Some fold/task effects persist, so the problem is not localized to one isolated run.
failure_reason_ranking.evidence: 13 of 24 fold-task runs are below macro-F1 0.50.

decision_matrix.evidence_for: Designed to pull same-affect samples from different subjects together and counter subject-dominated embeddings.
decision_matrix.evidence_against_or_risk: Will fail if label/task signal is intrinsically weak or batch sampler does not provide valid cross-subject positives.
decision_matrix.recommended_scope: implementation/spec objective before training; lock positive/negative pairs and sampler

decision_matrix.evidence_for: Explicitly penalizes risk variance across subject environments; matches subject-heldout failure mode.
decision_matrix.evidence_against_or_risk: Needs enough per-environment samples and careful environment definition.
decision_matrix.recommended_scope: pair with CE and optionally SupCon in controlled first pass

decision_matrix.evidence_for: May improve signal quality if feature representation is poor.
decision_matrix.evidence_against_or_risk: Previous preprocessing/feature change did not address cross-subject affective alignment.
decision_matrix.recommended_scope: only after subject-targeted methods are specified or if analysis later rejects subject-variability hypothesis

decision_matrix.evidence_for: Could handle subject-specific baselines if calibration samples are scientifically allowed.
decision_matrix.evidence_against_or_risk: May violate pure LOSO/zero-calibration setting; needs explicit protocol.
decision_matrix.recommended_scope: separate protocol objective if allowed by research claim

decision_matrix.evidence_for: May be needed if even subject-targeted losses cannot find signal.
decision_matrix.evidence_against_or_risk: Subject-relative q33 already tested minimally and was insufficient alone.
decision_matrix.recommended_scope: revisit after SupCon/DG design decision or if within-subject signal is weak

interpretation.diagnosis_validity: Subject variability remains a leading blocker; current failure does not falsify it.
interpretation.intervention_adequacy: The tested intervention was too weak/incomplete because preprocessing and CE-only training do not enforce subject-invariant affective representation.
interpretation.supcon_dg_justification: Affective SupCon and VREx/DG are justified for design, but positive/negative pairs, sampler, environment definition, and leakage constraints must be specified before training.
interpretation.feature_engineering_position: Generic feature engineering should not be the primary next step unless future analysis rejects subject variability as the blocker.

not_authorized: direct SupCon/DG training without implementation/spec review
generic feature engineering as primary next step
